1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.PlanarDirections
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.TriangleEdgeHalfplanes
3 
4 /-! The root-moving step in Kiazyk's wedge argument, in Cartesian coordinates.
5 
6 The two source images are `(0,h)` and `(0,-h)`. The root is `(r,0)`.
7 The upper outer ray has direction `(a,b)` and the lower one is its reflection.
8 The chosen region is to the left of the two inner legs. The definition covers
9 diverging rays, a bounded wedge, and the complement of a bounded wedge.
10 No boundedness or convexity of the wedge is assumed.
11 -/
12 
13 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
14 
15 open Set
16 
17 /-- The region bounded by the two inner segments and the two outer rays. -/
18 def region (h r a b : ℝ) : Set Plane := {z |
19   (h ≤ |z 1| ∧ (if 0 < b then b * z 0 ≤ a * (|z 1| - h) else 0 < a)) ∨
20   (|z 1| ≤ h ∧
21     (if 0 ≤ b then h * z 0 ≤ r * (h - |z 1|)
22      else if a < 0 then
23        h * z 0 ≤ r * (h - |z 1|) ∧ b * z 0 ≤ a * (|z 1| - h)
24      else h * z 0 ≤ r * (h - |z 1|) ∨ b * z 0 ≤ a * (|z 1| - h)))}
25 
26 /-- Horizontal sections of the kite with base `(r,0)--(q,0)` and apices `(0,±h)`. -/
27 def kite (h r q : ℝ) : Set Plane := {z |
28   |z 1| ≤ h ∧ r * (h - |z 1|) ≤ h * z 0 ∧
29     h * z 0 ≤ q * (h - |z 1|)}
30 
31 /-- The strict inequalities describing the inside of that kite. -/
32 def openKite (h r q : ℝ) : Set Plane := {z |
33   |z 1| < h ∧ r * (h - |z 1|) < h * z 0 ∧
34     h * z 0 < q * (h - |z 1|)}
35 
36 /-- Ordinary Cartesian coordinates in the public Euclidean plane. -/
37 def point (x y : ℝ) : Plane := !₂[x, y]
38 
39 private theorem upper_triangle {h r q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < h) (rq : r < q) (z : Plane) :
40     z ∈ convexHull ℝ ({point r 0, point q 0, point 0 h} : Set Plane) ↔
41       0 ≤ z 1 ∧ r * (h - z 1) ≤ h * z 0 ∧ h * z 0 ≤ q * (h - z 1) := by
42   have area : 0 < det (point q 0 - point r 0) (point 0 h - point r 0) := by
43     simpa [point, det, PiLp.sub_apply] using mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr rq) hp
44   rw [triangle_mem_iff_edge_sides _ _ _ _ area]
45   simp only [point, det, PiLp.sub_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
46     Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, sub_zero, zero_sub, zero_mul]
47   constructor
48   · rintro ⟨base, right, left⟩
49     exact ⟨(mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (sub_pos.mpr rq)).mp base, by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
50   · rintro ⟨base, left, right⟩
51     exact ⟨mul_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr rq).le base, by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
52 
53 private theorem lower_triangle {h r q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < h) (rq : r < q) (z : Plane) :
54     z ∈ convexHull ℝ ({point q 0, point r 0, point 0 (-h)} : Set Plane) ↔
55       z 1 ≤ 0 ∧ r * (h + z 1) ≤ h * z 0 ∧ h * z 0 ≤ q * (h + z 1) := by
56   have area : 0 < det (point r 0 - point q 0) (point 0 (-h) - point q 0) := by
57     have positive := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr rq) hp
58     simp [point, det, PiLp.sub_apply]
59     nlinarith
60   rw [triangle_mem_iff_edge_sides _ _ _ _ area]
61   simp only [point, det, PiLp.sub_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
62     Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, sub_zero, zero_sub, zero_mul]
63   constructor
64   · rintro ⟨base, left, right⟩
65     have nonpos : z 1 ≤ 0 := by
66       by_contra hz
67       have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (sub_neg.mpr rq) (lt_of_not_ge hz)
68       linarith
69     exact ⟨nonpos, by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
70   · rintro ⟨base, left, right⟩
71     exact ⟨mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (sub_neg.mpr rq).le base, by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
72 
73 /-- The coordinate kite is exactly the union of the two actual closed triangles. -/
74 theorem kite_eq_triangles {h r q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < h) (rq : r < q) :
75     kite h r q =
76       convexHull ℝ ({point r 0, point q 0, point 0 h} : Set Plane) ∪
77       convexHull ℝ ({point q 0, point r 0, point 0 (-h)} : Set Plane) := by
78   ext z
79   rw [mem_union, upper_triangle hp rq, lower_triangle hp rq]
80   change (|z 1| ≤ h ∧ r * (h - |z 1|) ≤ h * z 0 ∧
81     h * z 0 ≤ q * (h - |z 1|)) ↔ _
82   constructor
83   · rintro ⟨_, lower, upper⟩
84     by_cases positive : 0 ≤ z 1
85     · exact Or.inl ⟨positive, by simpa [abs_of_nonneg positive] using lower,
86         by simpa [abs_of_nonneg positive] using upper⟩
87     · exact Or.inr ⟨(lt_of_not_ge positive).le,
88         by simpa [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge positive)] using lower,
89         by simpa [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge positive)] using upper⟩
90   · rintro (⟨positive, lower, upper⟩ | ⟨negative, lower, upper⟩)
91     · rw [abs_of_nonneg positive]
92       refine ⟨?_, lower, upper⟩
93       have product : 0 ≤ (q - r) * (h - z 1) := by nlinarith
94       have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (sub_pos.mpr rq)).mp product
95       linarith
96     · rw [abs_of_nonpos negative]
97       simp only [sub_neg_eq_add]
98       refine ⟨?_, lower, upper⟩
99       have product : 0 ≤ (q - r) * (h + z 1) := by nlinarith
100       have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (sub_pos.mpr rq)).mp product
101       linarith
102 
103 /-- These strict inequalities describe the ordinary planar interior, including
104 points on the shared base of the two triangles. -/
105 theorem interior_kite {h r q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < h) :
106     interior (kite h r q) = openKite h r q := by
107   have cx : Continuous (fun z : Plane => z 0) := (EuclideanSpace.proj 0).continuous
108   have cy : Continuous (fun z : Plane => |z 1|) := (EuclideanSpace.proj 1).continuous.abs
109   have opened : IsOpen (openKite h r q) :=
110     (isOpen_lt cy continuous_const).inter
111       ((isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub cy)) (continuous_const.mul cx)).inter
112        (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul cx) (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub cy))))
113   apply Subset.antisymm
114   · intro z member
115     obtain ⟨ε, εpos, near⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp member)
116     have halfpos : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos εpos
117     have shifted (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < ε) : z + t • direction 0 ∈ kite h r q := by
118       apply near
119       change dist (z + t • direction 0) z < ε
120       simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_smul, direction_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht
121     have minus := shifted (-(ε / 2)) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos halfpos]; linarith)
122     have plus := shifted (ε / 2) (by rw [abs_of_pos halfpos]; linarith)
123     change _ ∧ _ ∧ _ at minus plus
124     simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, direction_x, direction_y, Real.cos_zero,
125       Real.sin_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero] at minus plus
126     have lower : r * (h - |z 1|) < h * z 0 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp halfpos]
127     have upper : h * z 0 < q * (h - |z 1|) := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp halfpos]
128     refine ⟨?_, lower, upper⟩
129     have height := minus.1
130     apply lt_of_le_of_ne height
131     intro boundary
132     rw [boundary, sub_self, mul_zero] at lower upper
133     linarith
134   · intro z member
135     exact mem_interior.mpr ⟨openKite h r q,
136       fun _ hmem => ⟨hmem.1.le, hmem.2.1.le, hmem.2.2.le⟩, opened, member⟩
137 
138 /-- The paper's range `π/2 ≤ γ ≤ 3π/2` gives exactly the outward condition.
139 The ray is obtained by rotating the vector from the upper apex to the root
140 clockwise by `γ`. -/
141 theorem outward_of_angle_range (h r γ : ℝ)
142     (lower : Real.pi / 2 ≤ γ) (upper : γ ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2) :
143     0 ≤ h * (-r * Real.sin γ - h * Real.cos γ) -
144       r * (r * Real.cos γ - h * Real.sin γ) := by
145   have cosine := Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le lower (by linarith : γ ≤ Real.pi + Real.pi / 2)
146   have product := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) (sq_nonneg h)) cosine
147   nlinarith
148 
149 /-- Moving the inner root to the right expands the region, with fixed outer rays. -/
150 theorem region_mono {h r q a b : ℝ} (order : r ≤ q) :
151     region h r a b ⊆ region h q a b := by
152   rintro z (outside | ⟨height, inside⟩)
153   · exact Or.inl outside
154   · refine Or.inr ⟨height, ?_⟩
155     have bound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right order (sub_nonneg.mpr height)
156     dsimp only at inside ⊢
157     split_ifs at inside ⊢ with up left
158     · exact inside.trans bound
159     · exact ⟨inside.1.trans bound, inside.2⟩
160     · exact inside.imp (fun hx => hx.trans bound) id
161 
162 /-- Every point gained by moving the root belongs to the intervening kite. -/
163 theorem region_subset_union_kite {h r q a b : ℝ} :
164     region h q a b ⊆ region h r a b ∪ kite h r q := by
165   rintro z (outside | ⟨height, inside⟩)
166   · exact Or.inl (Or.inl outside)
167   · by_cases before : h * z 0 ≤ r * (h - |z 1|)
168     · apply Or.inl
169       refine Or.inr ⟨height, ?_⟩
170       dsimp only at inside ⊢
171       split_ifs at inside ⊢ with up left
172       · exact before
173       · exact ⟨before, inside.2⟩
174       · exact Or.inl before
175     · dsimp only at inside
176       split_ifs at inside with up left
177       · exact Or.inr ⟨height, (lt_of_not_ge before).le, inside⟩
178       · exact Or.inr ⟨height, (lt_of_not_ge before).le, inside.1⟩
179       · rcases inside with lower | outer
180         · exact Or.inr ⟨height, (lt_of_not_ge before).le, lower⟩
181         · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨height, by simp [up, left, outer]⟩)
182 
183 /-- The nonnegative dot product says the outer ray points away from the old root. -/
184 theorem kite_subset_region {h r q a b : ℝ} (height_pos : 0 < h)
185     (outward : 0 ≤ h * b - r * a) : kite h r q ⊆ region h q a b := by
186   rintro z ⟨height, lower, upper⟩
187   refine Or.inr ⟨height, ?_⟩
188   dsimp only
189   split_ifs with up left
190   · exact upper
191   · refine ⟨upper, ?_⟩
192     have bneg : b < 0 := lt_of_not_ge up
193     have rpos : 0 < r := by
194       have hb := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg height_pos bneg
195       by_contra hr
196       have ra := mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (le_of_not_gt hr) left.le
197       linarith
198     have xnonneg : 0 ≤ z 0 := by
199       have := mul_nonneg rpos.le (sub_nonneg.mpr height)
200       nlinarith
201     exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg bneg.le xnonneg).trans
202       (mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos left.le (sub_nonpos.mpr height))
203   · exact Or.inl upper
204 
205 /-- Root movement adds exactly the kite; it cannot sweep up any other region. -/
206 theorem move_root {h r q a b : ℝ} (height_pos : 0 < h) (order : r ≤ q)
207     (outward : 0 ≤ h * b - r * a) :
208     region h q a b = region h r a b ∪ kite h r q := by
209   apply Subset.antisymm region_subset_union_kite
210   exact union_subset (region_mono order) (kite_subset_region height_pos outward)
211 
212 /-- Before the move, the next kite's inside is outside the wedge.
213 The second outward condition is the angle budget at the new root. -/
214 theorem next_kite_outside {h r q a b : ℝ} (height_pos : 0 < h)
215     (outward : 0 ≤ h * b - q * a) :
216     Disjoint (region h r a b) (openKite h r q) := by
217   apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
218   rintro z (outside | ⟨height, inside⟩) ⟨strict_height, lower, upper⟩
219   · exact (not_le_of_gt strict_height) outside.1
220   · dsimp only at inside
221     split_ifs at inside with up left
222     · exact (not_le_of_gt lower) inside
223     · exact (not_le_of_gt lower) inside.1
224     · rcases inside with old | outer
225       · exact (not_le_of_gt lower) old
226       · have bneg : b < 0 := lt_of_not_ge up
227         have apos : 0 < a := by
228           have anonneg := le_of_not_gt left
229           by_contra ha
230           have azero : a = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt ha) anonneg
231           rw [azero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at outward
232           exact (not_le_of_gt (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg height_pos bneg)) outward
233         have qneg : q < 0 := by
234           have hb := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg height_pos bneg
235           by_contra hq
236           have qa := mul_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hq) apos.le
237           linarith
238         have xneg : z 0 < 0 := by
239           have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos qneg (sub_pos.mpr strict_height)
240           nlinarith
241         have positive := mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg bneg xneg
242         have negative := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg apos (sub_neg.mpr strict_height)
243         linarith
244 
245 /-- The root-moving and next-kite separation step, with ordinary planar interior. -/
246 theorem root_step {h r q a b : ℝ} (height_pos : 0 < h) (order : r ≤ q)
247     (old_outward : 0 ≤ h * b - r * a) (new_outward : 0 ≤ h * b - q * a) :
248     region h q a b = region h r a b ∪ kite h r q ∧
249       Disjoint (region h r a b) (interior (kite h r q)) := by
250   refine ⟨move_root height_pos order old_outward, ?_⟩
251   rw [interior_kite height_pos]
252   exact next_kite_outside height_pos new_outward
